claims.evidence: PRIDE description: leucocyte-depleted platelet-rich plasma; keywords Platelets.
PRIDE description says two biological replicates; two iTRAQ experiments (file prefixes TRAQ1/TRAQ2) assumed to correspond. Not stated explicitly.
Deposited ProteinPilot XML UI_INSTRUMENT = QSTAR Elite ESI; PRIDE field says only QSTAR.
QUANT_LABEL used flags in 130620GiovanniiTRAQ1all.xml and 130701GiovanniiTRAQ2all.xml; sample type iTRAQ 4plex (Peptide Labeled). Unused channel emitted as unused.

claims.value: MMTS Methylthio on C fixed; iTRAQ4plex on K and N-term fixed
claims.evidence: PRIDE description (MMTS) and ProteinPilot UI settings; biological modifications variable set not itemised (ProteinPilot probability table).
PRIDE description: strong cation exchange fractionation; B3-B14 = 12 fractions inferred from file names.
MSTOLERANCE/MSMSTOLERANCE in deposited search XML; Paragon calibrates automatically so these are nominal.
File-name suffix _2 interpreted as repeat injection of the same fraction.

limitations: Channel-to-condition mapping (control/collagen/TRAP/ADP) is not stated in PRIDE and the paper is paywalled (Thromb Haemost 2015, PMID 25903651); treatment is therefore not available and no factor value is declared.
Biological replicate 1/2 = iTRAQ set 1/2 is an assumption from the PRIDE description.
Age, sex, ancestry, individual and pooling status are not available (15 volunteers, no per-sample data).
Only .wiff files are claimed as data files (48); the 48 .wiff.scan companion files belong to the same acquisitions and are not listed separately.
Dissociation method and reduction reagent not stated; set to not available. Variable (biological) modifications of the Paragon search are not itemised and omitted.
Fraction order B3..B14 mapped to fraction identifiers 1..12; _2 repeat for each fraction treated as technical replicate 2.
Instrument from search XML (QSTAR Elite) overrides PRIDE field QSTAR.
